t.64-02-8.agn: Its harmonised classification is harmful if swallowed and serious eye damage. It breaks down slowly in the environment, so some products have switched to readily biodegradable chelating agents such as MGDA.
t.64-02-8.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 607-428-00-2 (ATP01): Acute Tox. 4 (Oral)*, Eye Dam. 1.
t.64-02-8.what: Neutralises water hardness by binding metal ions and slows down product spoilage.
